title: Run a cleanup action once at scope exit
prompt: ScopeExit owns a cleanup function. Run it once when the guard is destroyed unless dismiss() was called. Disable copying so two guards cannot run the same cleanup. Single-threaded use; the callback is assumed not to throw.
signature: class ScopeExit: constructor(std::function<void()>), destructor, void dismiss()

tests.label: Normal scope
tests.hint: The destructor runs as the guard leaves scope.

tests.label: Two guards
tests.hint: Each guard owns its own action.

tests.label: Exception unwinding
tests.hint: A destructor also runs when a stack frame unwinds.

hints: The destructor is called automatically as the object ends.
Check active_ before invoking the owned callable.
explanation: Resource acquisition is initialization (RAII): a local owner ties cleanup to its own lifetime. This guard models cleanup without a manual call on every return path.
